Summary: 10 requirements assessed: 9 satisfied, 1 in conflict with the design, 0 partially covered, 0 not addressed, 0 with unclear design wording, 0 not assessable. Conflicts: REQ-010.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for every online banking session.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-001: Every online banking session will require username, password, and an OTP delivered through the customer's registered mobile number.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design requires username, password, and OTP via mobile number for authentication, matching MFA for online sessions.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-002: The system shall complete 95% of fund transfers within 3 seconds under a load of 1,000 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-002: The transfer API will target a response time of 3 seconds for 95% of requests under 1,000 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design targets 95% of requests within 3 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users, matching the requirement's metric, scope, and time.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate fund transfers when a user retries a request due to a network timeout.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-003: Each transfer request will include a unique idempotency key. Previously processed requests with the same key will return the original transaction result without executing another transfer.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design uses idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transfers when a user retries due to network timeouts.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-004: For every successful fund transfer, the system shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-004: The source account debit and destination account credit will be executed as part of a single atomic database transaction. Both operations will be committed together or rolled back together.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design ensures atomic database transactions for debiting and crediting, preventing partial updates.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-005: Transaction data will be replicated to a secondary region every 5 minutes. The disaster recovery procedure targets service restoration within 30 minutes.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design targets 30-minute RTO and 5-minute RPO through replication and disaster recovery procedures.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-006: Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-006: Transaction audit records will be retained for 10 years in append-only storage. Application administrators will have read-only access, and audit records cannot be modified or deleted through application interfaces.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design retains audit records for 10 years in append-only storage with read-only access and protection against modification.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-007: External API communication will use HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher. Internal service-to-service communication will also use TLS 1.2 or higher.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design uses TLS 1.2 or higher for external and internal communications.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-008: The system shall reject a fund transfer if the source account has insufficient available balance at the time of transfer execution.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-008: The transfer service will validate the source account's available balance immediately before initiating the debit operation. Transfers with insufficient balance will be rejected.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design validates source account balance before initiating transfers and rejects insufficient balances.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-009: The system shall notify the customer through email or SMS within 60 seconds after a successful fund transfer.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-009: After a successful transfer, the notification service will queue an email or SMS notification for delivery within 60 seconds.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design queues notifications for delivery within 60 seconds after successful transfers.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-010: The system shall support fund transfers of up to INR 500,000 per transaction.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-010: The transfer API will reject transactions exceeding INR 250,000 per transaction.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design rejects transfers exceeding INR 250,000, which is less than the requirement's INR 500,000 limit.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design rejects transfers above INR 250,000, but the requirement allows up to INR 500,000.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-010 and DESIGN-010 (INR 500,000 vs INR 250,000) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.
